---
title: "Twinned Cities"
---

TidyTuesday Challenge: https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2026/2026-05-12/readme.md

```{r}
cities <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-05-12/cities.csv')
links <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-05-12/links.csv')
```


```{r}

```

























```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)

city_links_map <- function(country, city_name = NULL) {
    selected <- cities |> filter(countrycd == {{ country }})
    if (!is.null(city_name)) {
        selected <- selected |> filter(name == {{ city_name }})
    }
    ids <- selected |> pull(id)

    links_coords <- links |> 
        filter(source %in% ids | target %in% ids) |> 
        left_join(cities |> select(id, lng, lat), join_by(source == id)) |> 
        rename(src.lng = lng, src.lat = lat) |> 
        left_join(cities |> select(id, lng, lat), join_by(target == id)) |> 
        rename(tar.lng = lng, tar.lat = lat)

    lngs <- as.vector(rbind(links_coords$src.lng, links_coords$tar.lng, NA))
    lats <- as.vector(rbind(links_coords$src.lat, links_coords$tar.lat, NA))

    leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 1, maxBoundsViscosity = 1)) |> 
        addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap.Mapnik",
                         options = providerTileOptions(noWrap = TRUE)) |> 
        setMaxBounds(-180, -90, 180, 90) |> 
        addPolylines(lng = lngs, lat = lats, weight = 1, opacity = 0.5) |> 
        addControl(city_name, position = "topright")
}
```

```{r}
#| layout-ncol: 2
city_links_map("US", "Minneapolis")
city_links_map("US", "Saint Paul")
city_links_map("US")
```
